entities.summary: Michel Polnareff is a French singer-songwriter. He gained prominence in the 1960s and remained active in France until the 1990s. His popular songs include "La Poupée qui fait non" and "Love Me, Please Love Me", which incorporate elements of pop and rock. He has been noted for his stage persona and theatrical stage performances and is referenced in discussions of French popular music.
